messages:
kira: starting canary for hera13b-int4, hitting sporadic OOMs and 99p tail when concurrent batches >=4.
ben: can you share the canary flags (batch_max, batch_timeout_ms, prefetch, max_new_tokens, eviction)?
lina: note: mixed prompt lengths have caused KV fragmentation before, watch kv_free_fragments and active_slots.
kira: current flags:
model: hera13b-int4; batch_max=8; batch_timeout_ms=20; prefetch=true; max_new_tokens_default=240; soft_eviction=false; kv_prefetch_slots=32
sam: prefetch + large max_new is suspect. try prefetch=false and cap max_new to 120 and lower batch soft limit to 15ms.
devbot: queued perf matrix: batches 1,2,4; max_new 64,120,240; prefetch on/off.
kira: quick matrix results: prefetch=on batch=4 max_new=240 -> OOM x3, 99p ~780ms. prefetch=off batch=4 max_new=240 -> OOM x1, 99p ~560ms. prefetch=off batch=2 max_new=120 -> 0 OOMs, 99p ~240ms.
lina: supports fragmentation hypothesis: long prompts (~700 tokens) create large KV entries that, when prefetched, leave unusable fragments under concurrent allocation.
sam: propose safe canary defaults: batch_max=4; batch_timeout_ms=15; prefetch=false; max_new_tokens_default=120; soft_eviction=true. Pin to hera-canary pool.
kira: deployed to pool-hera-canary (10 instances).
infra-bot: canary deploy started. Running synthetic load QPS=120 mix 30% long/70% short.
kira: after 45m: 0 OOMs, 99p ~250-290ms, occasional small spikes ~320ms.
lina: did ablation toggling soft_eviction=false?
kira: ablation produced 2 OOMs in 30m when soft_eviction disabled, re-enabled it.
sam: file infra ticket for telemetry to detect repeated large-kv allocs per session (>3 in 2s) + automatic rollback threshold.
kira: INFRA-8742 opened and added onboarding note: "mixed-length models: start with prefetch=false and conservative max_new_tokens until mem-frag validated."
ben: any QoE/quality regression from lowering max_new?
devbot: QA run against canonical prompts: no meaningful metric regressions (deltas <0.6%). Edge-case long-tail checks OK.
kira: summary: root cause = prefetch + high max_new + concurrent batches -> KV fragmentation -> intermittent OOMs/tail. Mitigation = conservative defaults (batch_timeout 15ms, prefetch=false, max_new_default 120, soft_eviction=true), telemetry, gradual rollout. Plan: 24h clean canary then 50% pool rollout.
sam: +1, merge to prod when 24h clean and infra alerts green.
kira: closing thread and updating model-onboard checklist. :rocket:
